tours.name: Add an Employment Type
tours.description: Learn how to add an employment type, such as Permanent or Contractor, so that it can be chosen on employee and contract records.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to add an employment type, such as Permanent or Contractor, so that it can be chosen on employee and contract records.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Employment types are configured in the Employees app and reused on employee and contract records.

description_i18n.en_US: Employment types are configured in the Employees app and reused on employee and contract records.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Employees app, such as employment types, departments and work locations.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Employees app, such as employment types, departments and work locations.

steps.title: Employment Types
steps.description: Employment types describe the kind of job an employee has, for example Permanent, Fixed term or Intern. They are chosen on the employee and on the contract.

description_i18n.en_US: Employment types describe the kind of job an employee has, for example Permanent, Fixed term or Intern. They are chosen on the employee and on the contract.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to add a line.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to add a line.

steps.description: The New button adds an empty line at the bottom of the list, ready to type in.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button adds an empty line at the bottom of the list, ready to type in.

steps.title: Name
steps.content: Type the name, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name, then press Tab.

steps.description: Use the wording your company uses in contracts, for example Fixed term. It is shown in lists and on contracts.

description_i18n.en_US: Use the wording your company uses in contracts, for example Fixed term. It is shown in lists and on contracts.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the line.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the line.

steps.description: The line is only stored once you save it. After saving it is available everywhere this list is used.

description_i18n.en_US: The line is only stored once you save it. After saving it is available everywhere this list is used.

steps.title: The list
steps.content: The new line is now part of the list. Click the column headings to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The new line is now part of the list. Click the column headings to finish.

steps.description: Lines can be edited later by clicking them, and removed or archived when they are no longer needed.

description_i18n.en_US: Lines can be edited later by clicking them, and removed or archived when they are no longer needed.
